from_node.description: Heidegger's Bremen lectures describe Gestell as universally ordering present beings into Bestand and connect the diagnosis with planetary totality.

to_node.description: Every modern technology and every technological practice can therefore be fully explained as one homogeneous instance of the same Gestell structure without detailed analysis of design, artifacts, institutions or mediation.

scale_check.bridge_burden: Need cross-domain discriminators showing how the Gestell model outperforms detailed engineering, mediation, institutional and artifact analyses rather than subsuming them by definition.

audit.native_domain: Heidegger technology diagnosis vs current philosophy of technology

rivals.description: Current philosophy of technology criticizes monolithic black-box approaches and studies artifacts, engineering practice, design, values, mediation, control and responsibility in differentiated ways.

ge4.alternative_disclosure: current technology philosophy provides plural artifact/design/mediation/governance analyses; Heidegger himself preserves other modes of revealing
ge4.discriminator: the model must identify patterns that are not guaranteed merely by being modern/technical and must allow counterinstances or gradations
ge4.revision_trigger: repeated inability to distinguish strongly different technologies, institutions or practices except by redescribing all as ordering
